author: The Linux Foundation
description:
The 2025 CNCF Annual Cloud Native Survey highlights how cloud native technologies have become foundational infrastructure for modern workloads, including AI.

From deployment velocity to GitOps adoption, the data points to a clear shift: success in AI depends on reliable, sustainable systems built on open source.

Learn more: https://hubs.la/Q0407DMH0
title: CNCF Annual Cloud Native Survey: The infrastructure of AI’s future
